summary: Iteration 2 verified the 3 new features (Settings, Expiring quotes alert, Excel export) + regression on auth/customers/quotes/transactions/dashboard. Backend: 31/31 pytest passed (added 10 tests: TestSettings x2, TestExpiringQuotes x3, TestExcelExport x5). Frontend E2E: Settings save & persistence OK; dashboard shows expiring-alert with expiring-quote-<id> for a quote due in 3 days and correctly excludes far-future quotes; Excel download completes (5372-byte .xlsx). QuoteView shows logo + print button + phone/email/address/tax fields.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: if user types into settings fields while the initial GET /api/settings is still in flight, the response resets/overwrites the input (setForm({...empty, ...data}) runs after render). Fix: set a `loaded` flag and gate rendering of inputs until data loaded, OR use uncontrolled defaultValue.

company_name (Firma Adı) is NEVER rendered on the quote document. The letterhead heading uses only `tagline`. If user leaves tagline empty but fills company name, the quote shows no company name at all. Add: {company?.company_name &&
{company.company_name}
} above tagline block in /app/frontend/src/pages/QuoteView.js:60.

action_items: Render company_name (Firma Adı) in QuoteView letterhead - currently only tagline shows so users filling only company name see nothing.
Settings page: guard against initial GET overwriting user input (add loaded state or defaultValue approach).
critical_code_review_comments: QuoteView.js letterhead intentionally hides company_name field - likely oversight; should display it prominently as the primary heading.
Settings.js setForm({...empty, ...data}) in useEffect runs unconditionally after mount; a user-typed value can be clobbered by a slow API response.
compute_quote_totals still applies VAT on pre-discount subtotal - carried from iteration 1, business decision to confirm.
Dashboard aggregates up to 5000 txns in Python - will slow at scale; consider aggregation pipeline.
next_quote_number races via count_documents; may reuse numbers if quotes deleted.
seed_data_creation: Test data was created and CLEANED UP by both pytest fixtures and a browser-side cleanup evaluate() that deleted UI_TEST customers/quotes, TEST_ prefixed transactions, and reset /api/settings back to defaults (company_name='Rhisos Mobilya', all other fields empty). DB should be clean for end user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: /app/backend/tests/test_rhisos_backend.py (31 tests, pytest, parallel-safe with xdist). New tests: TestSettings, TestExpiringQuotes, TestExcelExport (uses openpyxl to inspect xlsx). Excel export endpoint /api/transactions/export MUST be declared BEFORE /api/transactions/{tid} in server.py (currently correct). Sidebar testid nav-settings goes to /settings. QuoteView bug: company_name not rendered in letterhead - main agent should add it above tagline in QuoteView.js line ~61.
rca of the issue:
QuoteView letterhead RCA: The letterhead block conditions on `company?.tagline || phone || email || ...` and lists tagline/phone/email/address/tax but never renders company_name. Repro: Firma Ayarları -> set only 'Firma Adı' -> save -> open any quote -> letterhead shows logo but no company name text. Fix: insert `{company?.company_name &&
{company.company_name}
